page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head centred at the top and the page number at the top right. No margin notes. At the foot, the signature "D" at left and the catchword "nul-" at right.

main_text.p: nione hominum. 2. Quia si forte adversarium interemerit, peccabit, qui vitam & bona inter se æquaverit, cum nulla sit proportio inter bona & vitam hominis, ut postmodum prolixe demonstrabitur. 3. Quia præstat quem habere mentem recti conscìam[?], ut parum curanda opinio famæ apud homines, quam turbatam & commotam conscientiam, propter necem alicui illatam.

Negari tamen non poterit, quin recte qui innocens est, duellum suscipiat, ab adversario calumniatore oblatum, modo,ad id à judice cogatur, aliter morte ignominiosâ afficiendus. Hâc tamen adhibitâ cautelâ, ne tam ad vindictam cum iniquo congrediatur adversario, quàm ad defensionem, cujus modus illi à judice præscriptus erat. Cum enim

page.notes: The long s is read as a plain s throughout ("fi" as si, "eft" as est, "poftmodum" as postmodum). The word "conscìam" is an uncertain reading of the printed "confciam"; the [?] marks it. The printed ligature "ct" in "recte" is written as ct. The catchword "nul-" carries its printed hyphen. The text ends on the full line "Cum enim", so no half word is left at the foot.
